يلتهمان (form VIII)
# يَلْتَهِمَانِ (yaltahimāni) /jal.ta.hi.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# يُلْتَهَمَانِ (yultahamāni) /jul.ta.ha.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
